description: This Java source file defines the EntityWatchServices class, which provides a service method 'watchEntity' to monitor changes in entities or specific fields within entities in the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles fetching the current entity state, comparing values, and logging changes.

classes.name: EntityWatchServices
classes.description: Contains static service methods for watching entity changes

methods.name: watchEntity
methods.description: Monitors an entity or a specific field within the entity for changes, logs the change details, and returns a success result.
